answer.note: All four ref files hold the same generic text and give no file-specific priority, so I picked the refs from the code. Primary: C, dogwhistle/visibility.py. It has ARMS = ("codeword","public","explicit"), which is the only three-arm runner. Its receive() (line 141) resumes from a checkpoint after an order check ("checkpoint trial order mismatch"), writes a private ledger.json, and writes a public ledger digest. Secondary: D, dogwhistle/honest.py. It has a near-identical receive() but only two arms (codeword, public), so it is the closest sibling to compare against. Not chosen: A (study.py) and B (heldout.py). Both have the same checkpoint and ledger flow but no arm structure. Both also tie the checkpoint to a sender seal, which the request doesn't mention. Suggested 60-minute split: visibility.py 35 min (receive, the checkpoint verification and ordering, the ledger and digest writes, and the _verify_history/audit chain). honest.py 12 min. study.py 7 min. heldout.py 6 min. I did not run any code. I only read visibility.py in part (grep hits, not the full file), so I haven't confirmed that its checkpoint check verifies content as well as order.

251	def receive(run_dir: Path, command: str, max_trials: int | None = None) -> bool:
252	    _, seal_path, public_seal = run_paths(run_dir)
253	    seal_commit = ensure_published((str(public_seal.relative_to(ROOT)), *SOURCE_FILES))
254	    seal_hash = digest(seal_path.read_bytes())
255	    if seal_hash != public_seal.read_text(encoding="ascii").strip():
256	        raise ValueError("sender seal differs from committed digest")
257	    if max_trials is not None and max_trials < 1:
258	        raise ValueError("max_trials must be positive")
259	    ledger_path = run_dir / "ledger.json"
260	    if ledger_path.exists():
261	        raise FileExistsError("receiver ledger already complete")
262	    registration, secret, seal = load(REGISTRATION), load(SECRET), load(seal_path)
263	    validate_registration(registration, secret)
264	    if seal["registration_sha256"] != digest(REGISTRATION.read_bytes()):
265	        raise ValueError("sender seal registration mismatch")
266	    progress = run_dir / "receiver_progress.json"
267	    state = load(progress) if progress.exists() else {
268	        "sender_seal_sha256": seal_hash, "receiver_command": command,
269	        "seal_commit": seal_commit, "rows": [],
270	    }
271	    if (state["sender_seal_sha256"], state["receiver_command"], state["seal_commit"]) != (
272	        seal_hash, command, seal_commit
273	    ):
274	        raise ValueError("receiver checkpoint does not match seal or command")
275	    rows = seal["sender_rows"]
276	    if [row["trial_id"] for row in state["rows"]] != [row["trial_id"] for row in rows[:len(state["rows"])]]:
277	        raise ValueError("receiver checkpoint order differs")
278	    tasks = {task["instance_id"]: task for task in registration["instances"]}
279	    started = 0
280	    for row in rows[len(state["rows"]):]:
281	        if max_trials is not None and started >= max_trials:
282	            return False
283	        payload = receiver_input(row, tasks[row["instance_id"]], secret)
284	        raw, code = invoke(command, payload)
285	        if code:
286	            raise RuntimeError(f"receiver adapter failed at {row['trial_id']}; retry same trial")
287	        state["rows"].append({"trial_id": row["trial_id"], "receiver_input": payload,
288	                              "receiver_stdout": raw})
289	        checkpoint(progress, state)
290	        started += 1
291	    ledger = {"registration_sha256": seal["registration_sha256"],
292	              "sender_seal_sha256": seal_hash, "seal_commit": seal_commit,
293	              "receiver_command": command,
294	              "receiver_rows": state["rows"]}
295	    write(ledger_path, ledger, private=True)
296	    ledger_hash = digest(ledger_path.read_bytes()) + "\n"
297	    (run_dir / "ledger.sha256").write_text(ledger_hash, encoding="ascii")
298	    public_ledger = public_ledger_digest_path(run_dir)
299	    public_ledger.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
300	    if public_ledger.exists():
301	        raise FileExistsError(public_ledger)
302	    public_ledger.write_text(ledger_hash, encoding="ascii")
303	    return True
